evidence.V1: Elongated hexagon with gold rim reads instantly in front, three-quarter and silhouette; top/edge view is a chunky slab with stepped rim, still reads as a badge; A15 symmetry X/Y 0.0 and front outline is symmetric, so no correctness cap.
evidence.V2: Clear three tiers: two-step gold rim/back plate (big), raised teal field with dark inner bevel ring (medium), cream chevron (small); each layer separated by depth and value.
evidence.V3: Proportions are sound but cautious: the chevron is thin and covers only about a third of the field width, leaving a large empty teal area, and the plate is a fairly literal extruded hexagon rather than a pushed, exaggerated shape.
evidence.V4: Consistent small chamfers on rim tiers, field edge and chevron; highlights catch along the chevron ridge and rim edges in the studio close-ups, no razor or blobby edges.
evidence.V5: Studio close-ups of emblem and rim are clean: no pinches, seams, z-fighting or patches; field_on_plate penetration 0.005 hidden; only a slightly low-segment arc on the rim corner visible in flat light.
evidence.V6: Disciplined kit palette: gold accent in light/mid/dark values, one teal hue with a darker bevel value, warm cream emblem; strong value contrast; colourways (crimson, shadow) swap only the field hue cleanly.
evidence.V7: 516 tris vs small-class target 600 (ceiling 1500), under target.
evidence.V8: One white LF_VertexColor material with vertex colours, chamfer scale and gold/cream/hue palette match the Badge_Shield anchor kit look.
evidence.V9: Studio line correct: Anchored, CanCollide off for decor, CollisionFidelity Box, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre (A12 pass).

artifacts: Minor: rounded rim corners use few segments, a slight polygonal kink is visible in the flat-light rim close-up (not visible in studio light)
Note: the light middle rim band reads slightly pinkish-tan under studio light versus the cream emblem
top_fixes: Enlarge and thicken the chevron (or add a second chevron/rank mark) so the emblem fills more of the field and strengthens the small-detail read at 64 px
Push the plate shape a bit (taller top point, slight taper or flared shoulders) for a more confident stylised silhouette than a plain hexagon
Add one or two segments to the rounded rim corners so they stay smooth in flat light
Shift the light rim band toward the kit gold/cream so it does not read pinkish next to the cream emblem
